description: Fetches the last N log lines of an app from one of the nodes running it. Requires the owner key. The component is picked automatically when the app has one (private apps are decrypted with the owner key); otherwise the available names are listed.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

nodeIp.description: ip[:port] of the instance; defaults to the first running one.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_get_app_logs
title: Read container logs from a running instance
